rules.problem: Type and trigger are right and every red-box item is covered; the only invented breadth is 'Traumatic injury' (root of all injuries) standing in for 'preceding trauma' to the scrotum. rules.problem: Urgent matches 'Give urgent attention'; the (and presenting-complaint (or active_condition ...)) shape is the house pattern. Note the page escalates paraphimosis with glans blue/black to 'refer urgently' versus doctor-managed reduction otherwise; both stay Urgent so no level change is needed.

summary: Nothing on this page is invented: all 27 concepts exist and every red-box criterion, 'likely' diagnosis and the 'exclude testicular cancer' branch are encoded in the right rules and roles with the right certainty. The most consequential problem is 'Traumatic injury' (the root injury concept, not an ancestor of Injury of scrotum/testis) standing in for 'preceding trauma' in the torsion rule, which makes scrotal pain plus any recorded injury a probable torsion and an Urgent priority; replace it with 'Injury of male external genital organs' or drop it. 'Testicle out of place' and 'Testes - transverse lie' are nearest-available approximations of 'affected testicle higher/rotated', and the balanitis rule drops the page's 'if able to retract foreskin' precondition.
